title: LeeTKOB PA#3 problem fixtures
description: Exact RFC 9457 response bodies for every PA#3 problem type, pinned before implementation. Contract tests must assert these bodies (modulo the occurrence-specific `detail` sentence and `instance` path where a fixture marks them). The 403 `role-required` type covers both wrong-role requests and authenticated mutations whose CSRF proof or Origin is not accepted; the approved PA#3 error enumeration has exactly one 403 type and this mapping is recorded in AI-LOG D13.

fixtures.name: invalid-request
fixtures.condition: Malformed body, unknown members, trailing JSON, invalid field bounds, invalid UUID or invalid idempotency key.

body.title: Invalid request
body.detail: The request is not valid for this operation.

fixtures.name: authentication-required
fixtures.condition: Missing, malformed, expired or revoked session; login failures are generic and never disclose which part failed.

body.title: Authentication required
body.detail: Authentication is required to access this resource.

fixtures.name: role-required
fixtures.condition: Wrong role for the operation, or an authenticated mutation without a session-matching X-CSRF-Token / with a rejected Origin.

body.title: Role required
body.detail: Your account is not permitted to perform this operation.

fixtures.name: resource-not-found
fixtures.condition: Wrong route, or an absent/inaccessible resource. An unknown ID and another class's lab, source, submission or queue are deliberately indistinguishable.

body.title: Resource not found
body.detail: The requested resource does not exist.

fixtures.name: conflict-idempotency-content-mismatch
fixtures.condition: A completed idempotency key is retried with different request content. The stored result is not replayed.

body.title: Conflict
body.detail: The idempotency key was already used with different request content.

fixtures.name: conflict-submission-window-closed
fixtures.condition: The full bounded submission request completed at or after the lab deadline, so it is not accepted.

body.title: Conflict
body.detail: The submission window for this lab is closed.

fixtures.name: conflict-stale-revision
fixtures.condition: A TA decision or mutation targets a finding/lab revision that is no longer current.

body.title: Conflict
body.detail: The item changed before this request was applied.

fixtures.name: payload-too-large
fixtures.condition: The request body exceeded the bounded size limit before being fully consumed.

body.title: Payload too large
body.detail: The request body exceeds the accepted size limit.

fixtures.name: rate-limited
fixtures.condition: Login throttling exceeded per IP (10/minute) or per account identifier (10/15 minutes).

body.title: Rate limited
body.detail: Too many attempts. Retry after the indicated delay.

fixtures.name: unavailable
fixtures.condition: A required dependency such as the database is not reachable. The occurrence-specific detail names no internal topology details.

body.title: Service unavailable
body.detail: The service is temporarily unavailable. The request can be safely retried.

fixtures.name: internal-error
fixtures.condition: Unexpected failure. The detail sentence is fixed and generic; never exception text, stack traces, database details or secrets.

body.title: Internal server error
body.detail: An unexpected error occurred. The request can be safely retried.

notes: All protected responses carry Cache-Control: no-store.
Timestamps are RFC 3339 UTC with milliseconds.
instance is always the request path without a query string.
503 unavailable uses its fixture body above; no fixture value is asserted for its occurrence-specific detail.
